The '''Trulalis Stage Company''' was a troupe of actors who performed tragic plays on [[Trulalis]]. [[Otias Atori]] was one of their number, and the young [[Jaalib Brandl]] started his acting career with the company prior to [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].
